title.rendered: F.C Barcelona Kits 2025 – 26 For Dream League Soccer 2026

content.rendered:
Barcelona kit for season 2025 – 2026 can be imported by copying the DLS kits URLs below and pasting any of your preferred kit URL into any latest Dream League Soccer or older versions. The kits can also be imported into any FTS game also.

Barcelona Home Kit

Copy Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/g0SulEn.png

Barcelona Away Kit (25-26)

Copy Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/dDs5pCW.png

Barcelona Third Kit (25-26)

Copy Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/efKWKxB.png

Barcelona GoalKeeper Home Kit (25/26)

Copy Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/3CTz2Lf.png

Away Kit For Barcelona Goal Keeper (25/26)

Copy Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/PMEnLrC.png

Barcelona Team Logo

 Copy URL: https://ristechy.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/barcelona-logo.png
